cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：相关的
cards.example_en: These two maths problems are related and share a method.
cards.example_zh: 这两道数学题是相关的，而且解法相同。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: The zoo will release the healed bird next Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 动物园将在下星期六释放那只痊愈的鸟。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：度假胜地
cards.example_en: The seaside resort was crowded with families in July.
cards.example_zh: 七月里，海滨度假胜地挤满了来度假的家庭。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：不知道的
cards.example_en: The caller was unknown, so Mom did not answer.
cards.example_zh: 打电话来的人不知道是谁，所以妈妈没有接。

cards.scene: 娱乐休闲 · Entertainment and Leisure
cards.example_en: A clear understanding of the map helped us find the lake.
cards.example_zh: 把地图理解清楚之后，我们找到了那片湖。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：沟通；交流
cards.example_en: We communicate with our friends online.
cards.example_zh: 我们在线上与朋友沟通。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Poor communication made the relay team drop the baton twice.
cards.example_zh: 交流没做好，接力队两次把接力棒掉在了地上。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Inform the nurse if you feel sick at school.
cards.example_zh: 在学校身体不舒服时，要告诉校医。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: This leaflet gives information about bus routes to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 这张传单提供了去博物馆的公交路线信息。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: This photo shows Grandma standing in her garden.
cards.example_zh: 这张照片里，奶奶站在她的花园中。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: The usage of this camera is printed inside the box.
cards.example_zh: 这台相机的用法印在盒子里面。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: We argued about the film we saw on television.
cards.example_zh: 我们就在电视上看到的那部电影争论了起来。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: The beginning of the film made the children laugh.
cards.example_zh: 电影的开头把孩子们逗笑了。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: I still do not understand the meaning of the last line.
cards.example_zh: 我还是不明白最后一行的意思。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: The hotel has a quiet setting beside a small lake.
cards.example_zh: 这家旅馆坐落在小湖旁边，环境很安静。
